How change detection works

BARKLY DOCS stores a small local snapshot of discovered symbols and compares the next scan against it. The scanner uses static Python AST analysis and never imports or executes the project.

On the first generation, the existing project becomes the baseline. Later generations can identify newly discovered and changed functions, methods, classes, and API endpoints.
